source: Lines are copied from ai-companion backend/app/activities (outings.py fallback, choice_lines movie, closing_lines movie); a change there is not picked up here. The lines are spoken by the character (H3 dialogue), not burned in as subtitles (promo.subtitles = false). The cinema screen is never in frame (copyright, and H3 would invent a film): only its glow on her face.
